Author: Kadamode
Name: Sell Everything
Punchline: Price and liquidate marketable inventory through your retainer.
Description: Builds a reviewed sale queue from your inventory. HQ items use HQ listings, NQ items use NQ listings. Matching market prices below 100 gil are sold through the retainer; other items are listed one gil below the lowest matching offer. Includes whitelist and keep-quantity rules. Use /selleverything.
